S.TRANSL: 我今天七點到學校。
I arrived at school at seven today.

na'isnavaanin, kusianin a masnanava sian pasnanavaan, at tushit a lavian tu, "minduldula! pissauk!"
S.PHON: naʔisnavaanin kuɕianin a masnanava ɕian pasnanavaan at tus[x|χ]it a [l|ɬ]avian tu mindu[l|ɬ]du[l|ɬ]a pissauk
S.TRANSL: 上課了，老師走進教室，班長說:「起立!敬禮!」
It’s time for class , the teacher walked into the classroom, and the monitor said: “Stand up! Salute!”

tushit a kaimin tu, "mihumisang masnanava."

We said loudly, “Hi, teacher.”

tususulut a kaimin mas masnanavacia masipul, at kahuzas a kaimin mas huzassipul.

I have learned many ethnic languages.

kaupahanian a saikin kusian mas pasnanavaan.

I go to school every day,

kaupahanian a saikin mapasnava mas malisBunun.

I learn the ethnic language every day

napata'azaunku a inaak cina.

and I want to tell my mother.

inaak ngaan hai Alang.

My name is Alang.

inaak tu tama ngaan hai Biung.
S.PHON: inaak tu tama ŋaan [x|χ]ai biuŋ

My dad’s name is Biung.

inaak tu cina ngaan hai Savi.
S.PHON: inaak tu ʨina ŋaan [x|χ]ai savi
S.TRANSL: 我媽媽的名字是Savi。
My mother’s name is Savi.

punmas'an tu haminsan a saikin.

I am 10 years old.

Both my brother and I like to sing.

mazima saikin sunghaul, mais islunghu hai, muskun a kaimin tastulumah kudiip sunghaul.

I like swimming. During the holidays, our whole family go swimming together.

mazima saikin mapasahaal mas bahlu tu kaviaz, mahtu kaimin muskun kahuzas siin sunghaul.
S.PHON: maðima saikin mapasa[x|χ]aa[l|ɬ] mas ba[x|χ][l|ɬ]u tu kaviað ma[x|χ]tu kaimin muskun ka[x|χ]uðas ɕiin suŋ[x|χ]au[l|ɬ]
S.TRANSL: 我喜歡認識新朋友，我們可以一起唱歌和游泳。
I love meeting new people, we can sing and swim together.

saikin hai ituBunun tu uvaaz.
S.PHON: saikin [x|χ]ai itubunun tu uvaað
S.TRANSL: 我是布農族的小孩。
I am an Bunun child.

S.FORM: taikisian kaimin Nansalu.
taikisian kaimin Nansalu.
S.PHON: taikiɕian kaimin nansa[l|ɬ]u
S.TRANSL: 我們家住在南沙魯。
Our family lives in Nansalu.

S.FORM: kat'a'ima a kaimin.
kat'a'ima a kaimin.
S.PHON: katʔaʔima a kaimin
S.TRANSL: 我們家共有五個人。
There are five people in our family.

aizaan inaak tastulumah tu tatau uvaaz.
S.PHON: aiðaan inaak tastu[l|ɬ]uma[x|χ] tu tatau uvaað
S.TRANSL: 我們家有三個兄弟姊妹。
There are three brothers and sisters in our family.

muskun a saikin mas tama cina siin tuhasnanaz tuhaspingaz minhumis.
S.PHON: muskun a saikin mas tama ʨina ɕiin tu[x|χ]asnanað tu[x|χ]aspiŋað min[x|χ]umis
S.TRANSL: 我跟爸爸、媽媽、哥哥和姊姊住在一起。
I live with my father, mother, brother and sister.

malauskav a inaak tama, saia hai kisacu.
S.PHON: ma[l|ɬ]auskav a inaak tama saia [x|χ]ai kisaʨu
S.TRANSL: 我的爸爸很高，我的爸爸是警察。
My father is tall and he is a policeman.

S.FORM: matukulaaz a inaak cina, saia hai ising.
matukulaaz a inaak cina, saia hai ising.
S.PHON: matuku[l|ɬ]aað a inaak ʨina saia [x|χ]ai iɕiŋ
S.TRANSL: 我的媽媽很瘦，我的媽媽是醫生。
My mother is thin and my mom is a doctor.

S.FORM: palisBununun a kaimin mas inaak tu tama mais ilumah.
palisBununun a kaimin mas inaak tu tama mais ilumah.
S.PHON: pa[l|ɬ]isbununun a kaimin mas inaak tu tama mais i[l|ɬ]uma[x|χ]
S.TRANSL: 爸爸在家會和我們說族語。
My father speaks the Bunun language with us at home.

S.FORM: ku'asang a kaimin mais lunghulabal.
ku'asang a kaimin mais lunghulabal.
S.PHON: kuʔasaŋ a kaimin mais [l|ɬ]uŋ[x|χ]u[l|ɬ]aba[l|ɬ]
S.TRANSL: 我們暑假都會回部落。
We will all go back to the tribe during the summer vacation.

taskun a saikin mas masituhas madamu takula.
S.PHON: taskun a saikin mas maɕitu[x|χ]as madamu taku[l|ɬ]a
S.TRANSL: 我和兄姊會一起抓青蛙。
My brothers and sisters and I will catch frogs together.

S.FORM: madaidaz a saikin mas inaak tu tastulumah.
madaidaz a saikin mas inaak tu tastulumah.
S.PHON: madaidað a saikin mas inaak tu tastu[l|ɬ]uma[x|χ]
S.TRANSL: 我很喜歡我們家的人。
I like our family very much.

S.FORM: taskun a saikin aip mas inaak tu cina kudiip mapahainan.
taskun a saikin aip mas inaak tu cina kudiip mapahainan.
S.PHON: taskun a saikin aip mas inaak tu ʨina kudiip mapa[x|χ]ainan
S.TRANSL: 今天我和媽媽出去玩。
I went out with my mother today.

The sky is blue during the day, the weather is neither cold nor hot, and the wind is cool.

isian a kaimin masu'ismuut maun mas paang, mais sanvaliun hai masmuav tu mananghat.

We ate bread on the grass, the sun was shining on us, and it was very warm.

S.FORM: masa hanianin, cindanghas a dihanin.
masa hanianin, cindanghas a dihanin.
S.PHON: masa [x|χ]anianin ʨindaŋ[x|χ]as a di[x|χ]anin
S.TRANSL: 下午，天空變紅了。
In the afternoon, the sky turned red.

masingav saikin mas cina tu: mavia tu sambaiv a dihaninan i?
S.PHON: maɕiŋav saikin mas ʨina tu mavia tu sambaiv a di[x|χ]aninan i
S.TRANSL: 我問媽媽，為甚麼天空是紅彩色的。
I asked my mother why the sky is red.

S.FORM: antalam a cina tu, "adu nabalivusanin."
antalam a cina tu, "adu nabalivusanin."
S.PHON: anta[l|ɬ]am a ʨina tu adu naba[l|ɬ]ivusanin
S.TRANSL: 媽媽說，可能是颱風要來了。
Mom said, maybe the typhoon is coming.

uka a luum masa sanavan, at sandimaldimal a bintuhan.
S.PHON: uka a [l|ɬ]uum masa sanavan at sandima[l|ɬ]dima[l|ɬ] a bintu[x|χ]an
S.TRANSL: 晚上天上沒有雲，星星出來了。
There were no clouds in the sky at night, and the stars came out.

nakulumahin a kaimin.
S.PHON: naku[l|ɬ]uma[x|χ]in a kaimin
S.TRANSL: 我們也要回家了。
We were going home too.

masa isian daan, masi'aupa saikin mas bintuhan masumsum.
S.PHON: masa iɕian daan maɕiʔaupa saikin mas bintu[x|χ]an masumsum

On the way home, I made a wish with the stars,

mahtuang a balivusa nitu minsuma, aupa na'asa'ang saikin muhna kudiip mapahainan.

I hope the typhoon doesn't come, I still want to go out to play again.

mansisila a inaak pasnanavaan mas inaak tu lumah, kaupahanian a saikin kanbantas kusian pasnanavaan, at kanbantas amin kulumah.

S.TRANSL: 我的學校在我們家旁邊，我天天走路去學校和回家。
My school is next to our house, I walk to school every day, and I also walk home.

nii a inaam pasnanavaan madaing, kakauman a pantu, paha mapasahaal amin kaimin.

Our school is not big, there are not many students, everyone knows each other.

All the children will gather in the playground, play ball and chat together.

The teachers also play with us, the school is one big family.

kaupahanian a kaimin ma'asik, mapisaningsing mas pasnanavaan.

We have to clean every day, and everyone has to clean the classroom.

aiza bunun mahaishais mas siul, aiza ma'asik mas buav.

Some people clean the windows, some sweep the floor.

S.TRANSL: 我們還會打掃學校的各個角落，大家分工合作，學校每天都很乾淨。
We will also clean every corner of the school. Everyone works together, and the school is very clean every day.

kusian a saikin asang, masa takna tantungu sian inaak tu tamahudas.

Yesterday, I went to visit my grandpa in the tribe.

We haven’t seen each other for a long time and I miss him a lot.

masa usaduan a tamahudas mas zaku hai, mapakaunku mas suika, mapahuudku mas ucia.

As soon as grandpa saw me, he invited me to eat watermelon and drink tea.

madavus a itutamahudas sinsuaza suika, tuza tu masial kaunun.

The watermelon grown by grandpa is very sweet and really delicious.

mazima'ik amin mas itutamahudas tu ucia, masial amin huudan.
S.PHON: maðimaʔik amin mas itutama[x|χ]udas tu uʨia maɕia[l|ɬ] amin [x|χ]uudan
S.TRANSL: 我也喜歡爺爺的茶，也很好喝。
I also like grandpa’s tea, it’s tasted good too.

masa taunghuvali'in, muskunik mas cinahudas ma'anat mas pinittaunghuvali.

S.TRANSL: 中午的時候，我和奶奶一起煮午餐。
At noon, I cooked lunch with my grandma.

ma'anat a cinahudas mas vaivivaivi tu kakaunun, aiza mai'iskaan, aiza maitulkuk, aiza baat, aiza'ang maimumuan
S.PHON: maʔanat a ʨina[x|χ]udas mas vaivivaivi tu kakaunun aiða maiʔiskaan aiða maitu[l|ɬ]kuk aiða baat aiðaʔaŋ maimumuan

masa minaunin mas pinittaunghuvali hai, kusian kaimin pissanglavan kasanglav.

After lunch, we went to the vegetable garden to pick vegetables.
